content: .{@-उदरी@} <ab>N.</ab> of the wife of Rāvaṇa, regarded as one of the five very chaste women; <ab>cf.</ab> अहल्या. She advised her husband to deliver Sītā to Rāma and thus save himself from certain ruin, but he did not heed her; मन्दोदरीकुटिलकोमलकेशपाशमन्दारदाममकरन्दरसं पिबन्तः <ls>P. R. 1. 58</ls>.
